taskSources.label: DeepSWE v1.1
taskSources.measures: 113 original tasks across 91 real repositories in 5 languages, each requiring a large, novel change (not taken from public commits); pass@1 on hidden tests.
taskSources.note: Independent runs from the Mercor leaderboard where available; the rest are the vendors' own reported scores (llm-stats.com/benchmarks/deepswe-1.1).

taskSources.label: SWE-Atlas Codebase QnA
taskSources.measures: 124 deep code-comprehension questions on 11 production repos (Go, Python, C, TypeScript) — tracing execution across files, explaining behaviour and design. Agents must run and explore the code.
taskSources.note: Scores include the agent harness used (Claude Code, Codex or Mini-SWE-Agent).

taskSources.label: Terminal-Bench v2.1
taskSources.measures: 89 tasks in a real terminal: system administration, builds, environments, data processing, security.

taskSources.label: ITBench-AA
taskSources.measures: Root cause of real Kubernetes incidents from alerts, events, traces and topology snapshots, with shell access. Scored as precision at full recall (missing any true cause scores 0).
taskSources.note: Earlier entries (Opus 4.7 and below) were measured in June 2026.

taskSources.label: SciCode
taskSources.measures: 288 subproblems from 80 real laboratory problems across 16 scientific disciplines.

taskSources.label: LMArena Code Arena – WebDev
taskSources.measures: Blind pairwise votes by developers on web apps built by two anonymous models (Bradley-Terry rating).
